name: The Ancient Egg in Jintha'Alor

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: The search climbs to Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, where the Ancient Egg lies in a cave behind the high amphitheater. Its isolation makes it a fitting vessel in the story Yeh'kinya is assembling, though the place of discovery alone says nothing about what the egg can contain. The tablets and the relic now travel back into his keeping.
